verdict.rationale: Automatic model selection is a fair axis for a multi-provider coding agent, but the evidence shows no automatic routing. Users manually choose a model per agent (opencode-comm-1), and OpenCode Zen is only a curated list of tested models (opencode-docs-3). Neither picks the best model per task automatically, so both are adjacent at most.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the tool automatically pick the best model for each task
